parts.question: Compare adverse-event evidence in hn-204 and HN-402 for nausea

result.answer: In HN-204, the incidence of nausea for AX-17 was 12.7% and for Control was 6.0% [E1]. In HN-402, the incidence of nausea for AX-17 was 14.1% and for Control was 6.0% [E2]. Nausea was not serious in either study [E1, E2]. The treatment % for nausea in HN-402 was 1.4 points higher than in HN-204, while the control % remained the same [E4].
